items.t: Upstart’s CEO Keeps Buying the Stock, and Now Its Co-Founder Is Too
items.sum: Four times in three months, Upstart's CEO has bet his own cash on a falling stock, and each time the price kept sliding. Now his co-founder has joined in, with no trading plan to explain it.

items.t: Upstart Is the Real Loser in Intuit’s Credit Karma Guidance Cut
items.sum: Key TakeawaysIntuit cut its fiscal 2027 revenue growth outlook to 8%-9% from 9%-10%, and the whole cut came from Credit Karma, whose growth forecast fell to 3%-7% from 11%-13%. Credit Karma traffic produced 52% of Upstart’s loans in 2020, and Upstart still relies on it for many of its borrowers.

items.t: Upstart Sinks 11% and Block 12% in a Week as the Tech Rout Hits Fintech. Upstart’s CEO Keeps Buying
items.sum: Key TakeawaysUpstart fell 11% in a week as the Nov. 19-20 tech selloff dragged fintech stocks, Block among them, lower.

items.t: Forget JPMorgan: Upstart Has More to Lose From a 10% Card Rate Cap
items.sum: Key TakeawaysPresident Trump said on Nov. 21 that he would work with the incoming Democratic Congress to cap credit card interest rates at 10%, which would hit card issuers like JPMorgan and Capital One.
